name: Micronaut Core 5.2.1
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Iterate the introspections in a stable order again by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13096
* Keep a property's annotations to the type it is read through by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13099
* Find beans compiled before their annotation was self-indexed by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13111
### Other Changes 💡
* Fix the two critical Sonar issues failing the 5.2.x quality gate by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13095
* Only look up introspections in a class loader that shares the core types by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13109
* Make BinaryWebSocketSpec join ordering deterministic by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13094
* Serve the registered annotation type to a caller naming no class loader by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13114
* Compare nested type arguments by type in equalsType and typeHashCode by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13115
* Update managed-netty version to 4.2.18.Final by @sdelamo in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13097


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.0...v5.2.1
